case_goal: Remove all events from the course agenda of the '1 - Math' course
summary: Login as admin, navigate to course '1 - Math', open its Agenda, and clear all events via the 'Clear up event list' option, accepting the confirmation dialog.

steps.expected_result: Claroline homepage with login form and course categories is displayed
Logged in as admin; homepage shows user menu and course list
Course home page for '1 - Math' is displayed
Agenda page for the course is displayed with existing events and 'Add an event' / 'Clear up event list' links
All events removed; only 'Add an event' link remains in the event list section
